scope: Client-only owned read-only guide presentation and synchronous reply-correlation candidate. Not server authority, generic input ownership, or a deployed lifecycle service.

probe.scope: Read-only plan only; no apply/build/runtime validation.
probe.manifest:
[mod]
id = "pluto_guide_lifecycle_probe"
version = "0.1.0"
priority = 100
[compatibility]
horizon_revision = "624c4f6265c02296fbe8a80f029dd0d987fb94c0"

[[injection]]

ty = "Option<(u64, u64)>"
initial = "::core::default::Default::default()"
[[state.constructor]]
target = "horizon_client_render::chunk_map::<ChunkMap as Default>::default"
selector = "Self"
require = 1

rejected_alternatives.actual_result: E_BRIDGE_TARGET: generic bridge owner types are unsupported

rejected_alternatives.result: Insufficient source semantics: observe_screen returns with no trait mods, polls once per frame, compares only id/menu; identical reopen is invisible.
Level identity only; same-key Respawn and same-level book reopen keep it. Native allocator also uses wrapping fetch_add, so a separate checked nonce is required for strict nonreuse.
Real mod-owner association but no per-opening generation. Reopening by same owner is a no-op; different screen/pause behavior is not a book replacement.

rejected_alternatives.candidate: Legacy TConstruct request counter or first-span marker
rejected_alternatives.result: Counter echoes through current legacy wire but wraps and resets with ChunkMap; marker/title/current bytes cannot prove presentation identity or authority.

mutation_reset_inventory.effect: Replace/clear native book, including identical-content reopen.
mutation_reset_inventory.candidate: Invalidate before either entry; only a separately verified library opening operation may issue a new handle afterwards.

mutation_reset_inventory.operation: RunCommand takes book, closes, later prompt may restore directly
mutation_reset_inventory.effect: Restored bytes are not the original active capability.
mutation_reset_inventory.candidate: close_book revokes; also revoke at answer_command_prompt before direct restoration. Restricted library documents exclude RunCommand.

mutation_reset_inventory.operation: save_book takes book before matching Edit
mutation_reset_inventory.effect: Even a wrong-kind invocation can consume the current book.
mutation_reset_inventory.candidate: Revoke at save_book entry; editing itself is outside the owned read-only guide contract.

mutation_reset_inventory.operation: remote lectern page/book updates and close
mutation_reset_inventory.effect: Mutates pages or clears a lectern view directly.
mutation_reset_inventory.candidate: Lectern views are never admitted. A native opening of one revokes the earlier guide.
Every operation must require an actual supported current book. Subsequent native opening or command restoration also revokes. No current-value match may issue ownership.

mutation_reset_inventory.effect: Changes current page of the retained view.
mutation_reset_inventory.candidate: No new presentation identity. Reply presentation/page policy must be explicit; current capability does not promise input or navigation ownership.

mutation_reset_inventory.effect: Temporarily substitutes a different actor/window book.
mutation_reset_inventory.candidate: Entire service limited to construction-time Client role with no lan_acting; no server/guest window coverage.

mutation_reset_inventory.effect: Same-key branch retains ChunkMap and native epoch, but replaces player/loading context.
mutation_reset_inventory.candidate: Revoke before enter_remote_dimension on every call, not just world replacement.

mutation_reset_inventory.effect: Drops current level logically before next Login while old storage/epoch can remain.
mutation_reset_inventory.candidate: Revoke at mutable level-unload boundary; also reject absent player, reconfiguring and any active level load.

mutation_reset_inventory.effect: May first enter integrated closing-save; later discards Remote and World.
mutation_reset_inventory.candidate: Conservative revocation at leave entry, before early return/errors; discard record with its world. Early revocation is intentional, not an exact native screen-close event.
Revoke at entry; new owned map starts empty; process-wide nonreused nonce prevents later equality.

mutation_reset_inventory.effect: Processes current Remote queue in order. Disconnect/transfer returns, rather than feeding old remainder to new Remote.
mutation_reset_inventory.candidate: Do not move callbacks to network thread or retain packet borrows; validate current session synchronously after the official observer.

mutation_reset_inventory.effect: Owned record drops/moves with ChunkMap. Client enter_level returns before server parked-world swaps.
mutation_reset_inventory.candidate: Client-only scope plus checked global generation; no parked server or restored server record claim.

mutation_reset_inventory.effect: Owned non-Clone map; clear can be a no-op on an empty map.
mutation_reset_inventory.candidate: Explicit defaulted owned state is planner-supported. Conservative clear-entry invalidation must also run on empty clear. Membership revision is not a presentation identity.

mutation_reset_inventory.effect: Stored book, drawn book and admitted input are distinct.
mutation_reset_inventory.candidate: No automatic input interception in this candidate. Each presentation operation checks current context; hidden replies are rejected, not queued for later replay.

unperformed: No apply or host compile of the lifecycle probe.
No actual book opening/closing, respawn, disconnect, overlay or delayed-reply execution.
No complete package composition guard for these proposed hooks.
No request/reply protocol or owned guide API implementation.
conclusion: Official source and planner support a narrow mod-only candidate. Safe end-to-end session ownership is not yet established. Existing current-book capability remains synchronous only; do not ship a carrier on the strength of this plan.
